openPosePrompts.name: sunny
openPosePrompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent concept sheet for an original macOS desktop AI companion.
Create one polished two-pose character design sheet, square composition, genuinely transparent alpha background. Exactly TWO renderings of the SAME character, arranged side by side with generous empty transparent margins: left standing friendly idle pose, right sitting still with a small open dark laptop resting on its knees. Laptop lid bears a tiny cyan <> code symbol. Both full bodies completely visible, same head size, consistent materials and facial identity. Designed to remain charming and readable at a 96-pixel desktop size. Premium soft 3D toy illustration, rounded proportions, very large expressive friendly eyes, tiny hands and feet, crisp clean silhouettes, soft studio lighting. Smooth satin materials with restrained glossy highlights, delicate ambient shading on the character itself. No floor, pedestal, scenery, cast shadow on background, border, grid, text labels, logos, watermarks or interface elements. No motion lines. Leave all negative space fully transparent.
Subject: an extremely cute original butter-yellow bean-shaped baby robot, softly rounded capsule body, two oversized warm brown glass eyes in separate cream round sockets, tiny happy curved mouth, small charcoal rubber hands and chunky little feet, a short curved antenna tipped with a pale blue light, subtle teal side accents. Playful and cuddly like a tiny animated sidekick; simple mechanical seam details, no clothing. Give the standing version a small welcoming hand wave and the seated version an attentive happy expression. Clear robot construction, no screen face.
